answers.title: Moss Garden
answers.fantasy: Tend a small moss garden on a rainy hillside and grow it into a place visitors travel to see.
answers.audience: Cozy-game players who like slow, tidy progress
references: Viridi: tending small plants with no fail state
Islanders: placement that scores by neighbours
answers.never: Timers that punish you for leaving, or paid energy
answers.win: The garden earns its first visitor rating of five stones
answers.lose: Plants dry out if neglected, but the garden never ends
answers.slice: One bed, three moss types, rain on a seeded schedule, a visitor score
answers.art: Soft low-poly, wet greens, overcast light
answers.voice: Quiet, warm, a little wry; short sentences
pillars: Calm: rules out timers that punish leaving
Small and dense: rules out large maps
Readable growth: rules out hidden stats
answers.phase1: Plant moss by hand in one bed and water it; growth stalls once the bed is full, which makes you want more space.
answers.phase2: Open new terraces and lay stepping stones; visitors arrive and trample paths, so layout matters.
answers.phase3: A rainy-season festival tests the whole garden; a five-stone rating wins, then the garden stays open to keep tending.
